exercises.name: Hold S
exercises.notes: Begin by taking in a full breath and exhaling for as long as you can on the sound of an /s/. Repeat this for three or four breaths to establish a connection to the pattern of airflow. Try to produce the sound with consistent pressure, volume, and quality throughout.

exercises.name: Hold Z
exercises.notes: Change to the sound of a /z/ and maintain all consistency, including pitch now. Repeat this for three or four breaths.

exercises.name: Hold NG
exercises.notes: Change to the sound of /ng/ and increase your volume. This will engage the vocal folds more actively to help develop and strengthen them. Repeat for two to four breaths.

exercises.name: Hold M
exercises.notes: Then move to the sound of /m/ (hum) maintaining all the consistency you have built and to increase the amount of vibration you feel in your mouth, on your lips, and in your face.

exercises.name: M to Ah
exercises.notes: On the second breath, transition from the /m/ to the vowel sound /ah/. Use the full breath and hold the /ah/ for as long as you can do so comfortably.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.notes: Do a full-body warm-up consisting of dynamic exercises like leg swings, arm circles, jumping jacks, and high knees.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.notes: You can perform these on a Smith machine. A more horizontal position makes it more challenging. You can even elevate your feet on a gym bench or plyo box to make it more difficult. Train to an RPE 8-9 (leaving one to two reps in the tank at the end of each set).

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.notes: Pull the bar to your upper chest and slowly extend your arms. You should feel a stretch in your lats (upper back) as your arms extend.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.notes: Slowly lower the weight to feel a stretch in your upper back. Pull in one fluid motion.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Shrug your shoulders high in one fluid motion and pause briefly at the top position.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Pull the rope in one fluid motion and spread it in front of your face, engaging your upper back muscles by holding the position for a moment.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.notes: Do a full-body warm-up consisting of dynamic exercises like leg swings, arm circles, jumping jacks, and high knees.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.notes: Placing your feet close together and lower on the platform forces a greater knee range of motion, which leads to better quadriceps (front thigh muscle) activation.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.notes: Slowly extend your legs. You should feel an intense stretch in your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.notes: Slowly lower your heels to the floor for an intense calf stretch at the bottom and pause briefly instead of 'bouncing.'

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: Extend your arms fully on each rep and slowly bend them during the negative portion to keep tension on the triceps.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.notes: Do a full-body warm-up consisting of dynamic exercises like leg swings, arm circles, jumping jacks, and high knees.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Keep your abs engaged for stability, and press the dumbbells up and in. Lower the weights until your elbows are slightly below shoulder level.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.notes: Doing hip thrusts on a machine reduces the need to balance all the time. However, you can also do these with a barbell if your gym doesn't have this machine.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Shrug your shoulders high in one fluid motion and pause briefly at the top position.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.notes: Do reps slowly and with good control, especially as you bend your knees.

exercises.name: Cable Fly Crossovers
exercises.notes: Do reps slowly and bring your arms to the sides enough to feel a stretch in your chest muscles on each rep.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Pull the rope in one fluid motion and spread it in front of your face, engaging your upper back muscles by holding the position for a moment.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.notes: Do a full-body warm-up consisting of dynamic exercises like leg swings, arm circles, jumping jacks, and high knees.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.notes: Slowly lower the weight until you feel a stretch in your upper back, and pull in one fluid motion.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.notes: Placing your feet close together and lower on the platform forces a greater knee range of motion, which leads to better quadriceps (front thigh muscle) activation. Bulgarian split squats are a good alternative.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.notes: Set the bench height at the correct position for your elbows to remain close to your sides instead of flaring up.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
exercises.notes: Slowly lower the bar until your arms are straight, and squeeze your biceps at the top.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.notes: Slowly lower your heels to the floor for an intense calf stretch at the bottom and pause briefly instead of 'bouncing.'

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Keep your abs engaged, and draw your belly button toward your spine. Your lower back must not arch.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.notes: Do a full-body warm-up consisting of dynamic exercises like leg swings, arm circles, jumping jacks, and high knees.

exercises.name: Squat (Barbell)
exercises.notes: Experiment with the stance to see what feels most comfortable. Aim to get your thighs parallel to the floor and pause briefly at the bottom to limit the assistance from the stretch reflex. Front squats and leg presses are good alternatives.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.notes: Pull the bar to your upper chest and slowly extend your arms. You should feel a stretch in your lats (upper back) as your arms extend. Dumbbell rows are a good alternative.

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: Extend your arms fully on each rep and slowly bend them during the negative portion to keep tension on the triceps. You can also perform overhead dumbbell tricep extensions.
